ItemID: NA; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its experimental sound is less appealing than the heavier music I want right now.

ItemID: NA; Title: The Piper at the Gates of Dawn; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Psychedelic rock is not what I am seeking in this session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I want more of Tool's heavy riffs and intricate songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in 10.000 Days makes this a strong choice for another immersive Tool album.
ItemID: NA; Title: How to Dismantle An Atomic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its anthemic rock is less aligned with my current preference for heavier music.
